acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Codes stripped for Python-oracle parity and the codeless envelope frozen (wire-contract high; 1/2). Agreed: `main.go:1347` drops `repository-*` and `unsupported-git-object-format` codes; `cli.go:468-481` drops `map-unavailable`/`patch-unavailable`; CCF-V1-004 freezes the codeless form and lists `repository-*` as a frozen family clients cannot observe. Split: deliberate and test-pinned vs a quirk that the freeze makes permanent. Settles it: amend CCF-V1-004 so adding an optional `code` member to a codeless refusal is compatible (consistent with CCF-V1-006), or remove `repository-*` from the frozen family list. Cheap before rc.1, breaking after.
title: panel D3: Codes stripped for Python-oracle parity and the codeless envelope frozen
